mentions.name: ThreadShelf
mentions.description: A local-first archive for AI conversations that imports chats from providers lacking proper export options, such as Google AI Studio, OpenRouter, and LM Studio. It supports semantic search, MCP integration, and continuing old conversations with llama.cpp.
mentions.problem: AI chat providers like Google AI Studio, OpenRouter, and LM Studio lack sane export options, and no existing chat archive supported OpenRouter/Google AI Studio chats.
mentions.audience: Users of AI chat providers without proper export support, such as Google AI Studio, OpenRouter, and LM Studio
mentions.source_excerpt: Local-first archive for AI conversations for providers without sane exports like Google AI Studio, OpenRouter (including chats), LM Studio, and others, as I couldn't find any chat archive with OpenRouter/Google AI Studio chat support. It supports semantic search, MCP integration, and continuing old conversations with llama.cpp.
mentions.author: chrystianpl
